cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port your app can listen on (TCP). It is also passed to the app as the PORT environment variable

javaversion.desc: Version of Java (Eclipse Temurin) to run

jarfile.desc: Jar to run, relative to the server folder

jvmflags.desc: Extra flags passed to java before -jar, for example -XX:+UseG1GC -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8. An -Xmx here overrides the one taken from the memory

jarurl.desc: Optional. Direct link to a jar that the install downloads and saves as the jar file. Leave empty to upload the jar yourself

commands: bash -c "f=\"${JAR_URL%%\\?*}\"; f=\"${f##*/}\"; if [ \"$f\" != \"${jarfile}\" ]; then mv -f -- \"$f\" \"${jarfile}\"; fi; echo \"Saved ${jarfile}\""

command.command: bash -c "if [ ! -f \"${jarfile}\" ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: ${jarfile} not found. Upload your .jar to the server files, or set the JAR download URL and reinstall.\"; exit 0; fi; exec java${javaversion} -Xmx${memory}M ${jvmflags} -jar \"${jarfile}\""
